documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong operational performance in Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust demand in the commercial vehicle and trailer segments. Revenues from operations grew 80% year-on-year to INR 235 crores in Q2, with EBITDA standing at INR 30.6 crores. The company is actively executing capacity expansions, backward integration initiatives like the seamless tube facility, and increasing its export contribution. Despite pressures from rising commodity and consumable costs, management remains optimistic about stronger volumes in the upcoming quarters. Kross Limited reported strong operational performance in Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust OEM demand in the M&HCV segment and consistent tractor and agriculture segment demand.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2 based on current indications.
guidance.quote: Based on our current indication, we expect Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2.

guidance.claim: Management expects exports this year to be 45% higher than the previous year.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year, we expect this year to be 45% higher than our previous year.

guidance.claim: Q3 and Q4 volumes are expected to be stronger than Q2.
guidance.quote: Q3 and Q4 volumes expected to be stronger than Q2 and historically also H2 is always 10-15% up than H1.

guidance.claim: Capacity utilisation is expected to improve in the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: Capacity expansion investments are beginning to support growth, with utilisation expected to improve in the coming quarters.

guidance.claim: Momentum in the tractor segment is expected to continue into Q3.
guidance.quote: Momentum expected to continue into Q3; contribution of this segment set to rise over the coming years.

guidance.claim: The company expects a growth of 40% to 45% in its exports for the financial year.
guidance.quote: We are looking into having a growth of 40%, 45% in our exports for this financial year.

guidance.claim: Management targets export contribution to reach around 8% in the next two years.
guidance.quote: We've mentioned this before is that the plan is to have at least 8% of exports coming in in the next two years' time.

demand_outlook.claim: The momentum in the commercial segment has continued with robust demand indicated by the OEMs.
demand_outlook.quote: The momentum in the commercial segment has continued with robust demand indicated by the OEMs.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the Agri segment has remained consistent, and management expects this momentum to continue into Q3.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand in the Agri segment has remained consistent. We expect this momentum to continue into Q3, supported by relatively lower inventory levels of tractors in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: Momentum continued in the M&HCV segment with robust OEM demand.
demand_outlook.quote: M&HCV Segment: Momentum continued with robust OEM demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the tractor and agri segment remained consistent, supported by relatively low inventory levels of tractors in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: Tractor & Agri Segment: Demand remained consistent, supported by relatively low inventory levels of tractors in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: Trailer segment Q2 volumes exceeded Q4 FY26 levels.
demand_outlook.quote: Trailer Segment: Q2 volumes exceeded Q4 FY26 levels.

demand_outlook.claim: OEMs have indicated strong projections for September Q2 and subsequently Q3 and Q4 supported by healthy order books.
demand_outlook.quote: In spite of that, there has been indications from the OEMs for a strong September Q2 and then subsequently Q3 and Q4. These trends are first time supported by healthy order books.

demand_outlook.claim: The trailer segment is projecting good volumes with continued growth in the CV market.
demand_outlook.quote: Regarding the Trailer segment, with continued growth in the CV market, the trailer segment is also projecting good volumes.

demand_outlook.claim: The CV business is expected to grow well in terms of volumes this year with good projections indicated from September onwards.
demand_outlook.quote: So Mihir, the CV business is supposed to grow well in terms of volumes this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production of extruded axle beams has commenced with a current capacity of 7,500 units per month.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial production of extruded axle beams has commenced • Current axle beam capacity stands at 7,500 units per month

capex_expansion.claim: The extrusion line has been finally commissioned and productionized.
capex_expansion.quote: We have finally commissioned and productionized our extrusion line.

capex_expansion.claim: Progress on the seamless tube facility is on track with the piercing mill received and sizing and straightening mills on the high seas.
capex_expansion.quote: Progress on the seamless tube facility is on track. Piercing mill has been received, sizing and straightening mills are on the high seas and this is progressing as per schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: A high-pressure mold line for the foundry is expected to start in Q3 to double foundry capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: A high-pressure mold line for our foundry is expected to start in Q3. This will double our foundry capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs.
margins_costs.quote: While we have witnessed some pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs, the price revisions, including -- concluded with the OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support us during the Q3 and Q4.

margins_costs.claim: Price revisions with most OEMs and Tier-1 customers were concluded, supporting profitability despite input-cost pressures.
margins_costs.quote: Price revisions with most OEMs and Tier-1 customers concluded, supporting profitability despite input-cost pressures.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA grew by 39.5% year-on-year to 225.54 million with margin expansion to 12.23%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA grew by 39.5% year-on-year to 225.54 million with margin expansions to 12.23%, while PAT increased 24.4% year-on-year to 133.12 million.

margins_costs.claim: A steel price settlement retrospective to all suppliers has been given around July 15th at INR4,700 per kilo.
margins_costs.quote: One is with the commodity price increase, that is steel for us. So steel, there has been a very recent settlement which has been given retrospective to all the suppliers. This has just happened around the 15th of July where INR4,700 per kilo has been given.

margins_costs.claim: Quarter-to-quarter margins will expand driven by steel price compensation and conversion price increases.
margins_costs.quote: The impact is not totally, but quarter-to-quarter we will be expanding on margins and this will not only be compensated by the steel price, but also by the conversion increase.

orders_capacity.claim: Q2 trailer segment volumes have exceeded earlier record levels of Q4 of '26.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Q2 volumes have exceeded the earlier record levels of Q4 of '26.

orders_capacity.claim: Exports currently contribute approximately 8% of the company's component business.
orders_capacity.quote: Exports now contribute approximately 8% of our component business.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity of tipping jacks is 800 kits per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity of 800 kits/month providing substantial headroom for future growth.

orders_capacity.claim: Volumes on axles and suspensions have increased 30% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: The extruded axle beam has started production and volumes on axles and suspensions have increased 30% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company sold 226 tipping jacks in Q1 of FY27 and hopes to further scale this in subsequent quarters.
orders_capacity.quote: The successful ramp-up of tipping jacks has been encouraging for us. We have sold 226 in Q1 of FY27 and we hope to further scale this in the subsequent quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Overall axle volume in Q1 was almost at 9,500 numbers and suspension volumes were at around 3,200 to 3,300 numbers.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, the overall axle volume is almost at 9,500 numbers and the suspension volumes are at around 3,200, 3,300 numbers, both mechanical and air put together.

capital_allocation.claim: The company undertook a preferential issue to the tune of INR63.6 crores to focus on capacity expansion and gearing up for coming years.
capital_allocation.quote: The company is completely focused on capacity expansion and gearing up for the coming years, which is also witnessed by a preferential issue to the tune of INR63.6 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: IPO funds have been fully utilized as per plan towards capacity expansion and working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: On our fund utilization from the IPO, we have utilized fully as per the plan. This has been achieved and the funds deployed towards capacity expansion and working capital have been as per plan.

capital_allocation.claim: Necessary term loan and debt have been taken for the seamless tube facility.
capital_allocation.quote: And secondly, in terms of seamless tube, we have already taken the necessary term loan and debt for that.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management witnessed pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: While we have witnessed some pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs, the price revisions, including -- concluded with the OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support us during the Q3 and Q4.

risks_headwinds.claim: The months of June and July are periods where demands are slightly subdued due to monsoon.
risks_headwinds.quote: The period of June, July are where demands are slightly subdued due to monsoon.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to undertake production trials for the seamless tube facility in February or March of 2027.
management_commitments.quote: The sizing mill and straightening mills have been received and installed, and we plan to undertake production trials in February or March of 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to produce trailer axles exclusively through the extruded beam process by Q3 or Q4.
management_commitments.quote: This particular aspect of business by Q3 or Q4, we will be producing our trailer axles in this methodology only by the extruded beam process.

management_commitments.claim: Further volume scale-up of tipping jacks is expected in H2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Further volume scale-up is expected in H2 FY27 through a structured approach focused on product validation and customer satisfaction

management_commitments.claim: The company targets export contribution to reach approximately 8% in the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: We've mentioned this before is that the plan is to have at least 8% of exports coming in in the next two years' time.

management_commitments.claim: The high-pressure mold line for the foundry is expected to start in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: A high-pressure mold line for our foundry is expected to start in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: The axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to do production trials for the seamless tube facility by the end of the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So, I think by end of this financial year, we should be doing some production trials.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
